preconditions.description: The number of workers n must be between 1 and 5000.
The numerator a and denominator b of the parameter k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist of lowercase English characters excluding 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of obtainable job categories followed by the sorted list of obtainable job categories.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in obtainable_categories)
postconditions.description: All obtainable job categories must be present in the input string s.
The number of obtainable job categories must match the count c.
